modules.responsibility: GRC9V4(GRCV4) facade with explicit nine-port backend injection and combined model identity.
V4-owned ports/chart, fixed row basis/weight bridge, coarse/Split operations; no legacy rewrites.
Pure canonical D11-G9 allocator and identity-bearing resource/history plan; no caller target allocation override.
Discriminated exact unchanged GRC9V3 delegate; V4-defined-domain guard and explicit crossings, no field erasure.
Fresh candidate detection, separate expansion transaction, child completion and target/history initialization through generic admission. No combined beat/expansion commit.

test_matrix.subject: ports/chart
test_matrix.required_evidence: Nine ordered ports, endpoint uniqueness, fixed 3x3 chart, malformed envelope rejection.

test_matrix.subject: differential
test_matrix.required_evidence: Independent fixed-row gradient/Hessian/flux and A/C/disabled stage-specific weight bridge; not generic-backend substitution.

test_matrix.subject: trigger
test_matrix.required_evidence: Nine active ports AND semantic degeneracy, fresh post-beat candidate; candidate is neither expansion nor completed spark.

test_matrix.subject: coarse/Split
test_matrix.required_evidence: Actual column coarse-graining and Split operator; cache refresh is not evidence.

test_matrix.subject: allocator
test_matrix.required_evidence: D11-G9-P4a reserve-first same-port chiral primary spine, conditional phase, recursive BFS/rotor, capacity and deterministic event namespace; reject caller target allocation.

test_matrix.subject: C nonpersistent expansion
test_matrix.required_evidence: Exact C_OS vector identities, complete target reference map and full rederivation; no W_A or carrier loss invented.

test_matrix.subject: C persistent expansion
test_matrix.required_evidence: Execute nonnull carrier reset vector; whole-carrier zero reset and exactly carrier_history_loss, both digest preimages.

test_matrix.subject: A expansion aggregate
test_matrix.required_evidence: Close only after P9-8.3A.1 and P9-8.3A.2 are accepted for the same exact A scope; no inferred family-wide conformance.

test_matrix.subject: A specialization oracle production
test_matrix.required_evidence: Select and validate permitted A-history/initialization binding; independently construct concrete source/target, old/new-edge W, fixed-row/reference-current, distinct current/reset, W/Z loss, resource/receipt/readmission and rollback expectations outside the frozen release. Construction evidence, not production runtime output.

test_matrix.subject: A expansion implementation and comparison
test_matrix.required_evidence: Implement and test against the accepted pinned P9-8.3A.1 oracle for the same exact scope; independently verify current/reset reconstruction, W/Z history, readmission, receipts, rollback and replay. Do not replace the oracle with production results.

test_matrix.subject: vectors/covariance
test_matrix.required_evidence: All D30/D31/D45/D52 chirality/phase vectors and three metamorphic cases, signed-edge reorientation and phase boundaries; D37/D44 additional probes cannot replace D31/D52.

test_matrix.subject: readmission/rollback
test_matrix.required_evidence: Distinct current/reset resource map, occupancy, charge, independent target reconstruction, missing lineage/map failures, persistent ledger versus delta, whole-publication rollback.

test_matrix.subject: arbitrary-size review
test_matrix.required_evidence: Runtime deep D52 plus covariance and nonstall/capacity invariants required; construction witnesses alone do not close conformance.

test_matrix.subject: mandatory lifecycle
test_matrix.required_evidence: After 8.6: separate beat and expansion transactions, target readmission, charge, receipts, reset/replay and deep duplicate ownership for every consumed exact profile.

test_matrix.subject: disabled matrix
test_matrix.required_evidence: Forty independent exact delegate/input/oracle/result cells, scoped to unchanged V3 defined domain; no row/column inference.

test_matrix.subject: branch crossings
test_matrix.required_evidence: Both directions, distinct current/reset prestates, candidate/carrier loss channels, correct branch snapshot/reset semantics; no enabled event relabeled V3.

test_matrix.subject: legacy/full review
test_matrix.required_evidence: Unchanged legacy regressions and all applicable enabled, mandatory lifecycle and disabled evidence; enabled-only is not full GRC9V4 conformance.

test_matrix.subject: optional completion
test_matrix.required_evidence: Not selected: stabilization/completed-spark/hierarchy needs its own evidence if later advertised or explicitly required by a stronger handoff.

a_expansion_work.generic_authority_gap_route: Hold affected child and return the exact missing graph-generic contract to a bounded Tranche 7 correction through established authority/paper/spec/runtime propagation; no specialization workaround or unrelated claim reopening.
